A '''Form 98BG-HM7''' was a form in the bureaucracy of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] that, when filed, designated an ongoing emergency as a hostile invasion by ground forces. It was a specialized version of [[Form 98BG-H]].

==Appearances==
